title: The plans below show how the ground of a particular building has changed over time
prompt: The plans below show how the ground of a particular building has changed over time. Summarize the information by selecting and reporting the main features.
guideHtml:
HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT BÀI

– MAP (3 giai đoạn)

1. Giải thích đề

Sơ đồ cho thấy sự thay đổi chức năng của một tòa nhà qua 3 giai đoạn:

  • 1958–1984: office
  • 1985–2000: apartment
  • 2001–present: flower shop

→ Dạng: map – multiple time periods (3 stages)

2. Introduction (paraphrase)

Dùng cấu trúc:

The diagrams illustrate how a building was used for different purposes between 1958 and the present day.*
3. Overview (ý chính)
  • Tòa nhà trải qua 3 lần chuyển đổi chức năng lớn
  • Từ văn phòng → căn hộ → cửa hàng hoa
  • Bố cục bên trong thay đổi đáng kể theo từng mục đích sử dụng
  • Một số khu vực (như kitchen / entrance) vẫn giữ vị trí tương đối ổn định
4. Chia BODY
BODY 1 – Giai đoạn 1958–1984 (Office)
  • Bên trái:
  • Meeting room
  • Assistant’s office
  • Secretary’s office
  • Toilet
  • Bên phải:
  • Kitchen
  • Manager office
  • Reception area (gần entrance)

→ Ý chính: bố cục phục vụ làm việc hành chính, nhiều phòng chức năng riêng biệt

BODY 2 – Giai đoạn 1985–2000 (Apartment)
  • Bên trái:
  • Living room
  • Bathroom and shower
  • Bên phải:
  • Kitchen
  • Bedroom 1
  • Bedroom 2

→ Ý chính: chuyển thành không gian sinh hoạt, ít phòng hơn nhưng diện tích lớn hơn

BODY 3 – 2001–Present (Flower shop)
  • Bên trái:
  • Gift cards
  • Play area
  • Trung tâm:
  • Flower display area
  • Bên phải:
  • Kitchen (giữ nguyên vị trí tương đối)
  • Office
  • Flower section

→ Ý chính: chuyển sang mục đích thương mại, không gian mở và phục vụ khách hàng

5. Từ vựng nên dùng
  • be converted into → được chuyển đổi thành
  • undergo significant changes → trải qua thay đổi lớn
  • be replaced by → được thay thế bởi
  • remain unchanged → giữ nguyên
  • be repurposed → được tái sử dụng
  • layout → bố cục
sampleHtml:
The diagrams show how a building was used for different purposes between 1958 and the present.

Overall, the building changed from an office to a residential apartment and is now a flower shop, with each stage involving a complete reorganisation of internal space.

Between 1958 and 1984, the building functioned as an office. It contained several work-related rooms, including a meeting room, manager’s office, assistant’s office, and secretary’s office. Supporting facilities such as a kitchen, toilet, and reception area were also provided, all arranged around a central layout.

From 1985 to 2000, the building was converted into an apartment. The internal structure was simplified to suit residential use, with a living room occupying a large central area. Two bedrooms were added on the right, while the kitchen was positioned in the upper section. A bathroom and shower replaced the office facilities on the left.

Since 2001, the building has been used as a flower shop. The space is now divided into functional retail areas, including a flower display zone in the centre, a play area, and a section for gift cards. A kitchen and office are located on the right-hand side, reflecting both commercial and operational needs.
chartDescription:
TYPE: map/plan
TITLE: not present
UNITS/AXES: not present
SERIES/CATEGORIES:
1958-1984 OFFICE: Meeting Room, Assistant's office, Secretary's office, Toilet, Kitchen, Manager office, Reception area, Entrance
1985-2000 APARTMENT: Living room, Bathroom and shower, Kitchen, Bedroom 1, Bedroom 2, Entrance
2001-PRESENT FLOWER SHOP: Gift cards, Flower, Play area, Kitchen, Office, Flower, Entrance
DATA:
1958-1984 OFFICE:
- Meeting Room: top-left
- Assistant's office: middle-left, below Meeting Room
- Secretary's office: lower-middle-left, below Assistant's office
- Toilet: bottom-left, below Secretary's office
- Kitchen: top-right
- Manager office: middle-right, below Kitchen
- Reception area: bottom-right, below Manager office
- Entrance: bottom-center, below Toilet and Reception area

1985-2000 APARTMENT:
- Living room: top-left
- Bathroom and shower: bottom-left, below Living room
- Kitchen: top-right
- Bedroom 1: middle-right, below Kitchen
- Bedroom 2: bottom-right, below Bedroom 1
- Entrance: bottom-center, below Bathroom and shower and Bedroom 2

2001-PRESENT FLOWER SHOP:
- Gift cards: top-left
- Flower (area): middle-left, below Gift cards
- Play area: bottom-left, below Flower (area)
- Kitchen: top-right
- Office: middle-right, below Kitchen
- Flower (area): bottom-right, below Office
- Entrance: bottom-center, below Play area and Flower (area)

KEY FEATURES:
- The overall structure of the building remains largely the same across all three periods, with the entrance consistently located at the bottom.
- The kitchen has been a consistent feature in all three layouts, though its size and exact position have varied.
- The initial office layout featured multiple distinct office spaces and a meeting room, which were replaced by residential rooms in the apartment phase.
- The apartment layout introduced two bedrooms and a living room, converting the space from commercial to residential use.
- The current flower shop layout reintroduces a commercial function, featuring dedicated flower display areas, a gift card section, and a play area, while retaining a kitchen and an office.
- The "Flower" area in the 2001-present layout occupies a significant portion of the central and right-hand side of the building.
